source.check: every figure read from the page image; the same figures in the Banbridge Chronicle, 30 May 1908, p. 3

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Majority 463. Described in the nominations as: Hugh Morris (anti-direct labour).
